name: cascade-headless-cloudflare-example
description: Turn build123d Python into STEP/BREP/STL inside a Cloudflare Worker, using cascade-core headless. Every asset is a module of the script (64 MiB uncompressed limit). Flavors: build123d-lite (default), verbatim upstream build123d 0.13.0 (--env upstream), the real build123d wheel on Pyodide (--env real); --env warm boots lite at global scope.

scripts.dev:upstream: npm run prepare-assets && wrangler dev --env upstream
scripts.deploy:upstream: npm run prepare-assets && wrangler deploy --env upstream
scripts.dev:warm: npm run prepare-assets && wrangler dev --env warm
scripts.dev:real: npm run prepare-assets && npm run prepare-pyodide && wrangler dev --env real
